general.title: General Settings

welcome.summary: This app is a remote control for OpenCode running on your own computer.
details: Your computer does the real work: it runs the OpenCode server, the AI models and your project files.
Your phone connects to that server so you can chat with agents and follow their progress from anywhere.
The next steps take about a minute. Everything can be changed later in Settings.

permissions.summary: Optional: let the app notify you and listen to your voice.
details: Notifications tell you when an agent finishes a task while the app is in the background.
Voice input lets you speak prompts instead of typing them.
Nothing is requested until you tap Enable. You can skip both and turn them on later in Settings.

connect.summary: A server is the OpenCode server running on your computer. The app needs its address to reach your projects.
details: Scan QR code: pick this when your computer is showing a pairing code. It fills in everything for you.
Manual: pick this when you know the server URL, for example your https tunnel address, plus the username (usually opencode) and password.
Skip: continue without a server. You can add a connection later in Settings › Connection.

ai.summary: Choose which AI providers and models your server should use.
details: Providers (such as OpenAI or Anthropic) are configured on your OpenCode server; here you pick which ones to show.
You can skip this and keep the server's defaults.

project.summary: A project is a folder on your computer that OpenCode works in.
details: Pick the project to open first. Chats and file changes are kept per project.
Add a folder by entering its path on the server computer, not on your phone.

general.summary: Basic preferences such as language, theme and the default model.
details: These only change how the app looks and behaves on this phone.

ready.summary: Here is a summary of what you set up.
details: Tap Start coding to open the app. Anything missing can be added later in Settings.
